note: GFP state park on Roy Lake 3 mi SW of Lake City off SD-10, with two campgrounds about 3 km apart: the west campground on the peninsula beside the modern cabins and suites, and the east campground (where the pin sits). Both have tent sites and camping cabins; beaches, boat ramps, boat rentals and an island trail. --Claude
